capabilities.description: Watches the rink's ice temperature and puts the next upcoming session on hold when the ice stays too warm, so sessions don't run on unsafe ice.
capabilities.name: Ice quality monitoring and session safety holds

capabilities.description: A manager either releases a held session, which resumes ticket sales, or cancels it, which refunds every ticket through the payment provider.
capabilities.name: Held session resolution with ticket refunds

capabilities.description: Sends text messages to ticket holders, for example when their session is put on hold, and reports when the provider fails to deliver them.
capabilities.name: Ticket holder text notification

capabilities.description: Creates payment checkouts with the external payment provider, validates the provider's responses and refunds payments.
capabilities.name: Online payment checkout and refunds

capabilities.description: Stores the rink's sessions and looks up the schedule for a date range.
capabilities.name: Session schedule management
